$comment: One entry of readers.json: a family's helpers a dry reading may call (readers) and those that write (changers), or, under "methods", the method names. Generated by scripts/tool_needs.py; read by agentlink/needs.py.

changers.description: Helpers whose code writes the document, the selection, the window or a setting.

reading.description: Methods taken as readings by name.

pythonOnly.description: Reading methods that are Python's own: taken on a Python value only.

byShape.description: Names a sketch has as changes: a string's only by their arguments.
